title: Mosteiros e Correios assinam protocolo para modernizar toponímia municipal
why: Q4: protocol between Mosteiros municipality and Correios to digitise street names and door numbers, georeference them and integrate them into the national postal system, address databases and GIS.

title: Câmara de São Miguel quer todos espaços públicos identificados e casas numeradas
why: Q3: São Miguel is numbering houses in the urban centre first, with rural localities later, so coverage is still phased; about 400 door numbers fixed in Veneza.

title: FAQ
why: Q4: the national post asks for door number, postal code, city and island in the address and says the postal code is part of the address for delivery.

title: SDI/ToponimiaNacional
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território
why: Q3: national toponymy map service with layers for islands, municipalities, localities, neighbourhoods and the road network including rural roads; shows national infrastructure, not proof of full address coverage.

title: Política de Privacidade
why: Q4: the electricity and water utility says it collects customer address and geolocation; does not say the data come from a national address system.
